requirement: The hospital patient-record system shall use a distinct encryption key for each participating clinic so that one clinic's key can never decrypt another clinic's patient records.
The simulation software must keep the cryptographic keys of each tenant organisation in isolated key stores so that no tenant can read the model data of another tenant.
The database server shall assign each hosted customer its own encryption key hierarchy so that data encrypted for one customer remains unreadable to every other customer.
The compiler shall expose its plugin interface in a way that prevents third-party plugins from disabling or tampering with the compiler's code-signing and sandbox checks.

domain: payroll and human resources management system
requirement: The payroll and human resources management system must offer its extension API so that no extension can switch off, alter or evade the system's intrusion-detection and request-throttling controls.
The simulation software shall ensure that user-supplied scripts running inside it cannot deactivate or modify the software's attack-detection and lockdown mechanisms.
The online booking system shall erase the memory buffers holding a customer's payment details before releasing them so that no later session can read residual values.
The online banking application must overwrite any memory region that held account balances or transaction data before that region is allocated to another process.
The smart-home IoT controller shall clear memory that held camera streams or door-lock credentials before it is handed to any other task, preventing disclosure of leftover content.
The compiler shall deliver each intermediate representation passed between its compilation stages to the next stage without any modification.
The simulation software must verify that every message exchanged between its distributed simulation nodes arrives at the receiving node with its content unchanged.
The compiler shall present an interface to build plugins that makes it impossible for a plugin to bypass, switch off or corrupt the compiler's integrity-verification and hardening features.
The online banking application must provide third-party integrations with an interface through which they cannot evade, disable or tamper with its fraud-detection and brute-force protection controls.

domain: payroll and human resources management system
requirement: The payroll and human resources management system shall give integrated modules an access layer that prevents them from circumventing or deactivating its malicious-activity detection and blocking functions.
The smart-home IoT controller shall apply a change to its automation rules or firmware only when the change has been approved by the registered household owner.
The online banking application must permit modification of a customer's payee list only after the account holder has explicitly approved the modification.
The data warehousing system shall encrypt the datasets of each loaded data source while they are being ingested and, where configured, while they are queried afterwards.
The simulation software must encrypt scenario configuration files during their provisioning to a simulation node and may continue encrypting them during later runs.
The compiler shall encrypt proprietary source modules while they are being imported into a build workspace so that unauthorised parties cannot read them.
The hospital patient-record system shall return to each client module only the patient fields that the module's function needs and shall withhold all other fields.
The screen capture tool must grant integrated applications access only to the windows and screen regions they are actively authorised to record, and hide the remaining screen content.
The smart-home IoT controller shall let each connected app read only the device states needed for that app's purpose and conceal every other household sensor reading.
The database server shall encrypt all client connections using a negotiated channel protocol so that query traffic cannot be read in transit.
The web browser must transmit page requests and responses over an encrypted transport protocol so that eavesdroppers on the network cannot read their content.
The hospital patient-record system shall exchange patient data with external clinics only through an encrypted communication channel.
The database server shall support at least one encrypted replication protocol for traffic between primary and replica nodes so that replicated rows cannot be read in transit.

domain: payroll and human resources management system
requirement: The payroll and human resources management system must send salary files to external banking partners only over an encrypted transfer protocol.
The air traffic control software shall exchange flight-plan data between control centres using at least one encrypted link protocol that prevents interception of the content.
The simulation software should support symmetric-key encryption of saved simulation results so that stored results can be read only by holders of the key.
The online banking application shall encrypt stored customer statements with a symmetric block cipher so that anyone obtaining the storage media cannot read them.
The air traffic control software should be able to encrypt radar track records with a symmetric cipher so that unauthorised readers cannot interpret them.
The smart-home IoT controller may use public-key encryption to protect the pairing secrets exchanged with new devices from disclosure to nearby eavesdroppers.
The air traffic control software may use public-key encryption to conceal session keys when they are distributed to remote control towers.
The online booking system may employ public-key cryptography to encrypt customers' travel documents so that only the booking operator's private key can decrypt them.
